readme:
# inventory (demo target)

A tiny Python inventory library used as the scratch target for Mads-Lens demos.

Run the tests with `pytest`.

## Bug fix: `Inventory.low_stock`

`low_stock` in `inventory/core.py` used a strict `<` comparison, so items whose quantity was exactly equal to the threshold were left out, even though the docstring says "at or below." I changed the comparison to `<=`, so items at the threshold are now included, and `tests/test_core.py::test_low_stock_includes_threshold` covers this case.
finalText: I added a "Bug fix: `Inventory.low_stock`" section to `README.md` in the inventory project. It explains that `low_stock` in `inventory/core.py` used `<`, which dropped items exactly at the threshold, and that the fix changed it to `<=`. I didn't rerun pytest because this was a docs-only change.
